articles.title: Kolkata: Video shows crowd breaching barricades, tussling with cops day before stampede

articles.title: California farm earns 10 times more leasing land for solar than growing wheat
articles.summary: In Tulare County, California, the Changala family farm has embraced a transformative shift from dry-farmed wheat to solar energy. Driven by financial incentives, solar leases are now yielding significantly greater income compared to traditional crops.

In 1968, Cassandra Henderson graduated from a North Carolina school; 58 years later, she returned to its restored building, now 53 senior apartments
articles.summary: After years away, Cassandra Henderson has made her way back to Yanceyville, North Carolina, settling into the revitalized Dillard School Apartments. Originally a school from 1949 until 2002, this historical building has now been transformed into 53 affordable housing units for seniors, tackling the local housing crisis.

articles.title: Carrot Top issues first statement after suicide attempt; confirms new show
articles.summary: Comedian Carrot Top has bravely opened up about his recent suicide attempt, expressing heartfelt appreciation for the outpouring of love and support from fans. Grateful for their prayers and well wishes during this challenging period, he is now recovering surrounded by family after his hospitalization.

articles.title: Shamna Kasim says Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ is a dream come true
articles.summary: Shamna Kasim has shared her gratitude for being part of Rajinikanth's film 'Jailer 2'. She expressed appreciation for the director, producer, and composer for giving her the opportunity.

articles.title: Rajinikanth’s golden gift to Deva finds a place at the composer’s funeral
articles.summary: Rajinikanth’s heartfelt gift of a gold chain to Deva at the 'Annamalai' audio launch was a testament to their enduring friendship, remembered even after Deva's passing. The touching tribute of placing the chain on Deva's remains underscores their bond.
